authority.equilibrium_skill: .agents/skills/okhp3-equilibrium-review/SKILL.md read; conditional disruption applies because the three initial decisions materially agree.

question: Can a credible toe/join counterexample show the Loop02 toe gain is outweighed by source-inconsistent toe bulk, claw shortening, stance/contact loss or opposite/rear regression, or that the improvement disappears beyond first neutral/workshop impressions?

initial_review_concordance.scope: All three initial reviewers approve-with-limits modest development retention. Their correlated Sol family/source context and outcome reviewer prior excluded-head work weaken independence; this disruptor is a targeted challenge, not independent source-blind confirmation.

first_pixel_judgment: Before reading initial reports, the locked composite showed narrow, long, clearly articulated toes ending in pointed claws; the feet are legible against the floor at full-bird size. Loop01 and Loop02 canon neutrals appeared nearly identical at ordinary whole-bird scale, so I expected any meaningful FEET02 gain or cost to be subtle there and clearer in matched close views.

counterexample_hypotheses.falsifiable_claim: FEET02 design02 makes the distal toes visibly bulkier or the claws shorter/blunter than retained02, moving farther from the pinned source enough to cancel the local construction gain.
counterexample_hypotheses.test: At identical native 1280x853 paired canon, front, side, rear and far three-quarter pixels, compare retained02 and retained03 toe silhouettes and the source impression. Confirm or reject at ordinary whole-bird scale; use paired 1280x1280 feet-detail only to explain the shape difference.
counterexample_hypotheses.result: NOT SUPPORTED AS A REGRESSION. The retained03 feet show clearer segmented toe armor and tapered, pointed claw ends in the paired detail; the 090 side and 225 view do not reveal shortening or added toe bulk relative to retained02. At whole-bird scale the change is small and the toes remain more blocky than the pinned source, but the paired candidate does not become less source-like than its predecessor.

counterexample_hypotheses.falsifiable_claim: New toe/join pieces lift or detach visible claw tips, narrow planted support, or create an awkward opposite/rear silhouette that offsets the front gain.
counterexample_hypotheses.test: Compare identical retained02/retained03 neutral and workshop views at 000,090,180,225, emphasizing floor contacts, toe tip alignment and the rear 180 view; examine the remaining retained03 neutral 045,135,270,315 views for angle-dependent discontinuity.
counterexample_hypotheses.result: NOT OBSERVED IN THE FROZEN PIXELS. Feet remain visibly grounded in the front, side, rear and far-angle paired views; the rear and opposite profiles retain the same stance read, with no new floating toes or conspicuous support loss. This is visual contact evidence only, not physical or engineering validation.

counterexample_hypotheses.falsifiable_claim: The apparent segmented-toe gain is only a workshop highlight effect or only present in the first front/three-quarter view, disappearing under neutral light or other angles/era finishes.
counterexample_hypotheses.test: Check the same paired whole and cardinal angles under neutral and workshop light, then all three retained03 era canon-neutral/workshop and feet-detail images; compare the actual frozen pixel content at its supplied dimensions.
counterexample_hypotheses.result: FALSIFIED WITHIN SAMPLED VIEWS. The toe segmentation is visible in the neutral feet-detail and cardinal views as well as workshop; the broader lighting changes contrast but do not create the toe boundaries. The same geometry is present in Builder, Maker and Mechanic whole/feet evidence. It is a subtle whole-size improvement rather than a large silhouette change.

overall_countertest: No tested visual counterexample outweighs the modest FEET02 gain or shows an important stance/rear regression in the frozen sample. The opposing concern remains that the source has more slender, strongly articulated toes and much longer claw presence overall; this is an unresolved source-alignment gap, but it is not introduced by FEET02 relative to retained02. The observed whole-size foot gain is modest and localized.
implication: Countertest supports approve-with-limits development retention of retained03 for Loop03, with modest-gain language. It does not establish complete source likeness, physical stance validity, or owner acceptance. No release or publication decision.

technical_limits.source_matching: Qualitative review of supplied fixed views; source camera/depth matching is estimated, not calibrated.
technical_limits.engineering: No engineering, contact mechanics, fitment, manufacturing or certification was tested.
technical_limits.coverage: Visual comparison was selective: all three era source/whole canon references, all eight Loop02 Builder neutral angles, paired cardinal Builder neutral/workshop views and all three Loop02 feet details. Not every one of 138 paired native PNGs or video motion was inspected.
